name: Gaazeon's Blog public discovery
description: Public read-only MCP discovery metadata for Gaazeon's technical blog. The endpoint exposes machine-readable resources and read-only JSON-RPC tools for agents.

authentication.description: All listed resources are public and read-only. No OAuth, API key, or user session is required.

errorHandling.notFound: Unsupported /api/* paths return a JSON 404 body with canonical discovery resources.
errorHandling.fallback: If a discovery URL fails, retry the exact canonical URL once, then fall back to llms-full.txt, index.md, RSS, and sitemap files.
